Name: MarriageDialogue
Author: inetyoumc
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
In vanilla Stardew Valley, you can only talk to your spouse a couple of times per day — after that, pressing the interact key does nothing (or just kisses them over and over). This mod removes that limit. Talk to your spouse as much as you like, and every single click gives you something new.
